# Proposed fix: missing MLE runtime inference

The stop occurs in `02_tile_plan`, after scenario-assets evaluation passed round 2. No `sub_*.log` files are present in the supplied working folder. All six plans have empty `needs.runtimes`, despite verified Python and spreadsheet runners.

`plan_tiles.py:134` derives runtimes solely from `runtime_by_concept_prefix`, looking up the full concept ID or its first dot-delimited component (`mle`). The registry has no machine_learning_engineer profile and the default mapping is empty. Thus runtime inference emits an empty list; `run_pipeline.py:check_plan_gaps` correctly rejects sandbox interactions without a runtime.

Proposed implementation (not applied): add a machine_learning_engineer path profile with explicit full-concept runtime mappings: spreadsheet for concepts whose planned practice is formula_entry, and python for concepts whose practice is code_exercise. Infer requirements per hands-on step and its concept, rather than applying one prefix runtime to a mixed-runtime tile. Include spreadsheet_grid in the runtime-requiring interaction set, matching the driver. Preserve the existing verified-runtime gate and fail explicitly when a sandbox step has no runtime mapping. Do not use a blanket mle -> python mapping: the first tile includes spreadsheet formula work.

Test that mle.tile.019_020 requires spreadsheet (and any Python runtime required by its other hands-on steps), mle.tile.034_034 requires python, and every sandbox step in all six tiles has its intended verified runtime. Also test that an unmapped concept or unverified runtime still fails the gate. Regenerate tile plans and rerun the original driver command after an authorized maintainer applies and tests the fix. No source/configuration changes or rerun were performed during triage.
